questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the concept of error compounding, based on the quote: '95% right per step is 36% right after 20 steps.'?
options: Error compounding indicates that accuracy remains constant regardless of the number of steps.
Error compounding means that small errors at each step add up to a large overall error.
Error compounding occurs when each step is correct, leading to perfect overall accuracy.
Error compounding refers to the process of improving accuracy over time with each step.
questions.source_quote: 95% right per step is 36% right after 20 steps.

questions.stem: According to the statement 'An agent is a model using tools in a loop,' which of the following best describes the core concept of an agent?
options: An agent is a static model that provides one-time responses to specific queries.
An agent is a collection of tools that operate independently without any internal processing.
An agent is a human performing tasks with the assistance of external tools.
An agent is a system that continuously processes inputs and produces outputs through a cycle of tool usage.
questions.source_quote: An agent is a model using tools in a loop.

questions.stem: According to the statement 'The harness is everything that is not the model,' which of the following best defines the harness?
options: The harness refers to the physical structure of the model.
The harness is a subset of the model's components.
The harness includes all components that are not part of the model itself.
The harness is defined only by the model's specifications.
questions.source_quote: The harness is everything that is not the model.

questions.stem: According to the quote, 'The tool loop does the work. The feedback loop checks it,' which of the following statements is correct?
options: The tool loop performs the action, and the feedback loop evaluates the result.
The feedback loop is responsible for executing tasks.
The tool loop is responsible for monitoring and correcting errors.
The feedback loop ensures that the work is carried out correctly.
questions.source_quote: The tool loop does the work. The feedback loop checks it.
